definitions.explanation: A literary, bookish word meaning "nothing else compares." Almost always appears attached to another noun as a compound modifier, often in set phrases praising quality, strength, or beauty. Sounds elevated or old-fashioned; common in advertising copy, reviews, and written descriptions of masterworks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛快|つうかい}→痛快：08198_tsuukai⟧{無比|むひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{走力|そうりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無比|むひ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This athlete's running ability is said to be unrivaled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧{無比|むひ}な⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{数学者|すうがくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This mathematician, known for his matchlessly precise calculations, is highly regarded worldwide.

notes:
Made of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (nothing, absent) and ⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧ (comparison), literally "without comparison." The word almost never stands alone as a predicate in modern Japanese; it attaches to another noun or kanji compound to form fixed phrases, most commonly with a na-adjective style modifier slot. Register is noticeably literary — use it in writing, formal speech, or stylized advertising, not everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧{無比|むひ}: unrivaled accuracy
- ⟦{痛快|つうかい}→痛快：08198_tsuukai⟧{無比|むひ}: incomparably thrilling
- ⟦{勇猛|ゆうもう}→勇猛：22154_yuumou⟧{無比|むひ}: unmatched in bravery
- ⟦{強力|きょうりょく}→強力：02656_kyouryoku⟧{無比|むひ}: matchlessly powerful
- {無比|むひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧: peerless strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{比類|ひるい}ない→比類ない：21034_hiruinai⟧: matchless, beyond comparison — a near-synonym that works more naturally as a standalone predicate
- {類|たぐい}まれ: exceptional, extraordinary — emphasizes rarity rather than being simply "the best"
- ⟦{絶世|ぜっせい}→絶世：17116_zessei⟧: unparalleled (in the world) — used almost exclusively for beauty, as in ⟦{絶世|ぜっせい}→絶世：17116_zessei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧: unique, distinctive — about being one-of-a-kind, not about being superior
